skills.name: SQLMap engagement operations: Tie run to change ticket
skills.description: Make a low-impact SQLMap check auditable within the owner process.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Coordinate with the system owner and record approval/change reference.
2. Confirm test account, host, path, time window, monitoring contact, and stop criteria.
3. Record ticket, approved asset, parameter, schedule, and operator before using the app scan tool.
4. Run one app-scoped check at a time and close the loop with sanitized evidence.

Safety: target only owner-authorized scope via web.sqlmap with uthorized_target=true; keep defaults and stop on instability. Never dump data, use shells/file access, evade controls, or take destructive actions.
